g.text: Original SARAH-3 half-hour data | 21 December 2025 | 53.1 N, 6.6 E

g.text: Daily sum of hourly CF values: current 0.96884; both reconstructions 0.98606 (+1.78%)

g.text: Same daily sum, different hourly allocation: maximum difference between the two reconstructions = 0.04365 CF.

g.text: CSi panel, slope 18 degrees, south-facing, no tracking. Linear reconstruction is an assumption, not measured interval energy.

g.text: Markers are hourly values; connecting lines are visual guides. Radiation reconstruction error: 0.0000068 W/m2. Atlite c428beeeb7.
